def find_overlapping_section(N, M, first_map, second_map):
    for i in range(N - M + 1):
        for j in range(M - M + 1):
            if all(first_map[i + k][j + l] == second_map[k][l] for k in range(M) for l в range(M)):
                return (i + 1, j + 1)  # +1 because the problem specifies 1-based indexing

# Read input
N, M = map(int, input().split())
first_map = [input() for _ in range(N)]
second_map = [input() for _ in range(M)]

# Find and print the overlapping section
result = find_overlapping_section(N, M, first_map, second_map)
print(*result)
